item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 21/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, upper-air disturbances will bring showers and thunderstorms to the region and the northern part of the South China Sea. With the departure of the upper-air disturbances, showers will decrease over the coast of Guangdong towards the weekend.

Date/Month: 22/11 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers. Isolated thunderstorms.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium

Date/Month: 23/11 (Wednesday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore later.
Weather: Cloudy with showers and isolated thunderstorms. Showers will be more frequent at times.
Temp range: 21 - 24 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
